nodes.label: service music-file
nodes.does: A music bed from a file the client supplies: trimmed to the film, faded in and out (looped if short)

nodes.label: service voice-import
nodes.does: Any other voice (Fish Audio, OpenAI, Azure, a recording): one file per line; timings given or estimated

nodes.label: service captions
nodes.does: Captions (.srt) from the narration's word timings

nodes.label: service voice-cache
nodes.does: Copies a saved voice (vo-<voice id>/) into vo/ so no credits are spent again

nodes.label: service render
nodes.does: Draws every frame in headless Chrome and encodes the video with the mix

nodes.label: service voice-sapi
nodes.does: Free local Windows voice with native word timings, for timing drafts

nodes.label: service timeline
nodes.does: Lays the lines on the film's timeline: cues.js for the picture and the score, and the voice track

nodes.label: service mix
nodes.does: Levels the voice, the score (or a supplied bed plus the score's accents), ducks the music under the voice, normalises loudness

nodes.label: service voice-elevenlabs
nodes.does: Narration from ElevenLabs, with native word timestamps

nodes.label: service align
nodes.does: Replaces estimated word timings with ones measured from the audio (faster-whisper word timestamps)

nodes.label: service score
nodes.does: The film's music bed, accents on the same beats as the picture

nodes.label: service score-accents
nodes.does: The score's accents alone (score.js with BED=none), laid over a supplied music file

nodes.label: service intro
nodes.does: Builds the intro from its description (<film>/intro/, made by new_film.py) as a small film of its own, with the film's voice and loudness

nodes.label: service outro
nodes.does: Builds the outro from its description (<film>/outro/, made by new_film.py) as a small film of its own, with the film's voice and loudness

nodes.label: service deliver
nodes.does: Copies the rendered video to the delivery path (a film without captions)

nodes.label: service check
nodes.does: Delivery checks: video, loudness, timings, captions, bookends, end-card time, alpha rule

nodes.label: service bookends
nodes.does: Joins intro + film + outro (built from a description, or clips the client supplied in <film>/bookends/) into the delivered MP4, with one caption track across all three

nodes.label: service attach-captions
nodes.does: Puts the captions into the MP4 as a switchable subtitle track (not burned in)
